units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 16:8">Kel. XVI, 8</cite> <he>חפוי הא׳</he>, v. <cite ref="H01424"><he>חִפּוּי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Pesachim 57a:8">Pes. 57ᵃ</cite> <he>אוי לי מֵאַלָּתָן</he> woe to me (I am afraid) of their fork (weapon).
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 6:3">Sabb. VI, 3</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 63a:11">63ᵃ</cite>) ed. (Ms. <cite ref="A01770"><he>אלא</he></cite>); Y. ibid. 8ᵇ (expl. <he>דייקרן</he>).

senses.gloss: sign-pole, used in the barn as a mark. Ib.; Y. Maasr. I, 49ᵃ bot.; Tosef. Ter. III, 11 משתיעקר הא׳ (ed. Zuck. משיתעשר, corr. acc.) as soon as the sign-pole (fork) is removed (indicating that the grain is ready for use and priestly gifts).
